import con_rocketswap_official_v1_1 as rocketswap
__lockers = Hash(default_value=0, contract='con_liquidity_locker_v1_2',
    name='lockers')
__metadata = Hash(contract='con_liquidity_locker_v1_2', name='metadata')


def ____():
    __metadata['FEE_PERCENTAGE'] = decimal('2')
    __metadata['FEE_WALLET'
        ] = 'ff61544ea94eaaeb5df08ed863c4a938e9129aba6ceee5f31b6681bdede11b89'
    __metadata['OWNER'] = ctx.caller


@__export('con_liquidity_locker_v1_2')
def create_locker(token_contract: str, locker_name: str, lp_amount: float,
    lock_end_day: int, lock_end_month: int, lock_end_year: int):
    assert lp_amount > 0, 'Must provide lp points amount!'
    assert token_contract != None, 'Must provide token contract!'
    assert lock_end_day != None, 'Must provide end day of lock!'
    assert lock_end_month != None, 'Must provide end month of lock!'
    assert lock_end_year != None, 'Must provide end year of lock!'
    assert datetime.datetime(year=lock_end_year, month=lock_end_month, day=
        lock_end_day) >= now, 'Lock end cannot be in the past!'
    rocketswap.transfer_liquidity_from(contract=token_contract, to=ctx.this,
        main_account=ctx.caller, amount=lp_amount)
    rocketswap.transfer_liquidity(contract=token_contract, to=__metadata[
        'FEE_WALLET'], amount=lp_amount / 100 * __metadata['FEE_PERCENTAGE'])
    if __lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name] == 0:
        __lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name] = [lp_amount,
            datetime.datetime(year=lock_end_year, month=lock_end_month, day
            =lock_end_day, hour=0, minute=0, microsecond=0)]
    else:
        __lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name] = [__lockers[
            token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name][0] + lp_amount,
            datetime.datetime(year=lock_end_year, month=lock_end_month, day
            =lock_end_day)]


@__export('con_liquidity_locker_v1_2')
def end_locker(token_contract: str, locker_name: str):
    assert token_contract != None, 'Must provide token contract!'
    assert __lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name][1
        ] <= now, 'The end of liquidity lock is not reached yet!'
    rocketswap.transfer_liquidity(contract=token_contract, to=ctx.caller,
        amount=__lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name][0])
    __lockers[token_contract, ctx.caller, locker_name].clear()


@__export('con_liquidity_locker_v1_2')
def change_metadata(key: str, value: Any):
    assert ctx.caller == __metadata['OWNER'], 'Only owner can set metadata!'
    __metadata[key] = value
